Japanese AI Video Generator Free — Initial Release

- Launches a free AI-driven tool for generating Japanese-language videos from user text or images, outputting ready-to-post 1080p MP4 files.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG (up to 200MB), with backend cloud rendering and job management.
- Automatic token/session handling for both anonymous and registered users; grants up to 100 free credits with a 7-day validity for new users.
- Easy workflows: describe your video, upload inputs, and quickly receive a sharable MP4—no technical skills or expensive software required.
- Comprehensive error handling and status reporting for uploads, credits, session management, and exports.
- Built for Japanese content creators needing fast, high-quality video generation without hassle.
